parsed.summary: The PR introduces a necessary change to clear the lookup cache in _unregister_lookup, but it lacks a corresponding test to ensure the change works as intended.

issues.description: The PR does not include a new test to verify that the lookup cache is cleared correctly when _unregister_lookup is called. This could lead to undetected issues in the future.
